scope: Graphviz 16.1.0 official source built in an isolated prefix: bounded simple directed graphs, fixed boxes, TB/LR, DAG or explicit cyclic policy, trusted generated DOT, SVG and plain geometry. Four native branch/rejoin, orientation, topology-variant and cycle cases passed with independent literal membership/labels and geometry invariants; additional native numeric-label/reserved-ID and 200-node/500-edge cases passed. Refreshed-hash hostile probes, owned-child lifecycle, verified JSON value handoff, reuse, corruption invalidation and finite studies passed. No arbitrary DOT, clusters, typography, optimum layout or exhaustive version/build qualification. Receipt must be refreshed after shared source generation freezes.
acceptance: Build official stable source in isolated prefix; run tools/qualify_graphviz.py --graphviz /absolute/path/to/dot --output-directory evidence/graphviz-fresh. Review native output grammar, geometry, lifecycle and source-bound receipt before absorbing.
